content.text: Second- or third-degree AV block w Sx or hemodynamic compromise and ↓likelihood of coronary ischemia: β-adrenergic agonists (isoproterenol, DA, dobutamine, Epi) may be considered to improve AV conduction, ↑ventricular rate and improve Sx.
